title: Riffle rules
description: How an organisation manages its code, as flat typed rules (kind + match + value). Orgs may write any number of rules, but the compiler always reduces them to the fixed column set in x-riffle-model-columns. Undeclared means null, never 0. Adding a column is a schema version bump, a retrain, and a decision record. Rules are read point-in-time from git history of the rules file, and the compiled hash is pinned into model_version. Read from the default branch only; an invalid file keeps the last valid compiled rules and posts a notice. Org file: riffle/rules.yml in the org's .github repo. Repo file: .github/riffle/rules.yml, appended after org rules and limited to that repo.

schema_version.description: Rules format version as major.minor; the major must match this schema's x-riffle-version

includes.description: Other rule files in the same repo, so large orgs can split rules by team, e.g. riffle/rules/streams.yml. Resolved depth-first, max depth 2.

rules.description: Typed rules (kind + match + value) that the compiler reduces to the columns in x-riffle-model-columns

labels.description: How outcomes become the breakage target, label_bad. Defaults follow docs/adr/0002-label-target.md. The global model always uses the default target_sources with binary union; org changes here apply only to that org's per-repo layer. The merge-outcome target (docs/adr/0009-merge-outcome-target.md) is configured in merge_outcome.

target.description: union: label_bad = any target source fires (binary). weighted: each source's label_source weight becomes a sample weight. Per-repo layer only

szz_in_target.description: SZZ stays a separate label unless true

maturity_days.description: Rows younger than this are dropped before training (label_mature)

szz_maturity_days.description: Days before an SZZ label is mature, used for SZZ instead of maturity_days

unobserved.description: What to do when a label source had no data for a mature PR (e.g. CI results expired). Any observed source that fired still makes the row positive. Otherwise: mask drops the row; negative counts it as fully clean; downweight counts it as clean with sample weight unobserved_weight

unobserved_weight.description: downweight only. Multiplies the row's sample weight for each unobserved source (0.5 with one missing, 0.25 with two)

target_sources.description: Sources that can make a row positive. Others still get mined and reported as ablations, but do not enter the target

merge_outcome.description: Second training target (docs/adr/0009-merge-outcome-target.md): did the PR merge, and if not, why. Mined from each closed PR's timeline. Separate from label_bad and never mixed into it: target, target_sources and unobserved above apply to label_bad only.

enabled.description: Mine closed-unmerged PRs and the merge-outcome labels: label_merged, label_rework, label_duplicate, label_unwanted, label_abandoned, label_ci_technical, close_reason

rework_grace_seconds.description: Commits and force-pushes this soon after open are part of opening the PR, not rework. Also the cut for the at-open snapshot the features are computed from (docs/adr/0010-features-at-open.md)

abandon_days.description: A PR still open this many days after opening with no human non-author response counts as unmerged and abandoned

close_reason_classifier.description: llm: an LLM reads each unmerged PR's comments, reviews and labels up to close and picks close_reason, falling back to rules when the LLM is off or fails. Training data only, never the scoring path

stale_bot_logins.description: A PR closed by one of these accounts is abandoned

unwanted_labels.description: Labels present at close that mark the PR unwanted. Matched case-insensitively as substrings, so `rejected AI` counts

mining.description: Parameters for the mined, repo-local features in contracts/mined_features.schema.json. They change model inputs, so they are part of the compiled rules hash pinned into model_version. Every value has a default; most repos never set this block.

k.description: Number of nearest past PRs similar_pr_bad_rate is computed over

lookback_days.description: Days of past PRs searched for neighbours

min_neighbours.description: Fewer than this and the feature is null

lookback_days.description: Days of prior PR reviews counted

exclude_bot_reviews.description: Leave bot reviews out of revealed_path_scrutiny

min_prior_prs.description: Fewer prior PRs than this and the feature is null

lookback_days.description: Days of past bad changes on the touched paths counted

min_bad_changes.description: Fewer past bad changes than this and the features are null

failure_mode.description: Parameters for the path_failure_mode_* columns and path_detection_lag_days.

lookback_days.description: Days of past changes to the same files compared against

min_prior_changes.description: Fewer past changes to the same files than this and the feature is null

tag_pattern.description: Which tags count as releases, e.g. ^\d+\.\d+\.0$ for minor releases only

min_releases.description: Fewer release tags than this and the feature is null

interval_stat.description: Statistic over past release intervals used as the repo's typical release interval

flaky_detection.description: Marks checks flaky without test reports: a check that failed then passed on re-run at the same SHA. Adds to, never replaces, ci_check flaky rules

enabled.description: false turns off flaky detection from re-runs

min_rerun_passes.description: Failed-then-passed re-runs needed before a check is marked flaky

lookback_days.description: Days of check history searched for failed-then-passed re-runs

level.description: Which file this is: org for riffle/rules.yml in the org's .github repo, repo for a repository's .github/riffle/rules.yml

model.description: Settings that change what the model sees or learns. They live here, not in org-config, so they are hashed into model_version.

enabled.description: false serves the global model only (layer_weight 0)

max_layer_weight.description: Upper limit on layer_weight, the per-repo layer's share of the score (0 to 1)

per_repo_layer.description: The per-repo layer fitted on this repo's own outcomes on top of the global model (docs/adr/0001-global-first.md).

disabled_features.description: Feature names forced to null. Width of the vector never changes. Repos may only add. Example: agent_authored

backfill.description: On-install history mining. Recent history first so the per-repo layer can train within hours, then older history in the background

lookback_days.description: Days of history mined on install

recent_first_days.description: Most recent days of history mined first; older history follows in the background

sources.description: Where outcome data lives beyond GitHub. Credentials are secret references, never values.

id.description: Tracker identifier, referenced by the tracker field of link, issue_field and issue_label rules

credentials_ref.description: Secret reference for the tracker's credentials, never the value

trackers.description: Issue trackers, referenced by link and issue rules through their id.

id.description: CI source identifier, referenced by the source field of ci_check rules

provider.description: commit_status covers Jenkins, Buildkite and anything posting legacy statuses

context_glob.description: Glob over the check or status names read from this source

credentials_ref.description: Secret reference for the CI system's credentials, never the value

ci.description: CI systems beyond GitHub checks, referenced by ci_check rules through their id.

test_reports.description: Test reports read for test_class rules.

outcome_import.description: Lets an org push outcomes Riffle cannot see (internal incidents, internal reverts) to POST /v1/outcomes, keyed by commit SHA or PR. Contract: contracts/outcome_import.schema.json.

secret_ref.description: Secret reference for the secret that signs POST /v1/outcomes requests, never the value

kind.description: Rule kind, which decides the other fields the rule accepts

applies_to.description: Narrows where a rule applies. In a repo file, repos is ignored.

repos.description: Repositories the rule applies to; * is every repo

paths.description: Limit to a monorepo package, e.g. packages/react-native/**

priority.description: Conflict resolution: higher wins, then the more specific glob, then the later rule.

enabled.description: false turns the rule off without removing it

value.description: Criticality of the matching paths, low to critical, as 0-3 in max_criticality
Class of the matching files
Change type the matching paths signal

x-riffle-compiles-to: sharpens extractor touches_* features; no new columns
change_signal.description: Risky change types. Handled by the extractor's own path rules too; these declarations override its defaults per repo.

component.description: Names a monorepo package or module. The name is free text, but the model only sees generic stats computed per component from history.

value.description: Component name

exposure.description: Who the component is exposed to; max_exposure encodes internal 0, partner 1, external 2

data_class.description: Class of data the component holds; max_data_class encodes public 0 to restricted 3

regimes.description: Compliance regimes the component falls under, counted in regulated_scope_count

owner.description: Path ownership. import_codeowners reads CODEOWNERS instead of listing paths.

match.description: Path glob, or the CODEOWNERS path when import_codeowners is true

value.description: Team or login, e.g. @apache/kafka-streams

import_codeowners.description: Read ownership from the CODEOWNERS file at match instead of listing paths

value.description: What a match marks the change as

field.description: Text the regex is matched against

link.description: Connects objects Riffle would otherwise treat as unrelated. match must contain a named group (?<ref>...).

match.description: Regex with a named group (?<ref>...) that captures the reference

field.description: Text the regex is matched against

value.description: What the captured reference points to

x-riffle-compiles-to: commit-PR-issue graph used by every label source; cherry picks dedupe labels across branches

identity.description: Recovers the real person when a bot lands the commit or email differs from login. match needs a named group (?<login>...) or (?<email>...).

match.description: Regex with a named group (?<login>...) or (?<email>...)

on.description: Text the regex is matched against

value.description: Role of the recovered person

x-riffle-compiles-to: author_* features use the resolved author

merge_signal.description: What counts as merged. Needed when PRs are closed and the change lands another way.

value.description: How a change counts as merged

x-riffle-compiles-to: merged_at, merge_commit_sha for every outcome window

issue_field.description: Tracker fields beyond labels, e.g. Jira issuetype and priority.

value.description: What a matching issue counts as

tracker.description: Tracker the issue label is read from

value.description: What a matching issue counts as

match.description: Value to match in the field named by on

value.description: Class given to matching authors

new_contributor_days.description: Optional; overrides the default tenure cut for authors this rule matches

source.description: sources.ci entry; default is GitHub checks

value.description: auxiliary (CodeQL, Scorecards, coverage) never triggers ci_fail

test_class.description: Test-level flakiness from sources.test_reports, for repos with one giant CI check.

value.description: Class given to matching tests

match.description: Outcome source the weight applies to

value.description: Sample weight for this source in the org's per-repo layer, 0 to 2

window_days.description: Window in days for this source, in place of its default

label_source.description: Weight of an outcome source as a sample weight in this org's per-repo layer. Never applied to the global model. Windows: revert 30d, ci_fail on required checks only, hotfix is a hotfix-labelled PR on the same lines within 7d, follow_up_fix is any PR on the same lines within 14d.

value.description: Class of the matching branches; release and hotfix set targets_release_branch when they are the base branch

stack.description: Stacked PR tooling, so a stack is understood as related changes.

value.description: Stacked PR tool

match.description: Branch pattern or body marker the tool leaves

value.description: What the matching code handles

sensitivity.description: What the code handles. Split from change_signal so authn and authz stay distinct.

value.description: Policy to check against the diff

target.description: no_import_from: forbidden path glob. dependency_*: package names. regen_pair: generated path glob.

tests.description: required_tests: test glob that satisfies it; defaults to path_class test

languages.description: no_import_from only: languages to parse imports for. Others are skipped, and the feature is null for files in them

policy.description: Team policies checked against the diff. Each firing policy adds one to policy_violations; the specific policy is shown in the comment, not given its own column.

x-riffle-phase-notes.no_import_from: v1 for listed languages via tree-sitter import queries; other languages later
x-riffle-phase-notes.flag_required: later: heuristic on known flag SDK calls only

freeze_window.description: Declared code freeze. days_to_freeze_start is left to the extractor.

value.description: What the label means; priority also needs level

pr_label.description: Maps PR labels at open time. Different from issue_label, which is about linked issues.

value.description: Change kind treated as safe

safe_change.description: Which change kinds this team treats as safe. No match; the extractor classifies lines.

x-riffle-model-columns.frac_lines_in_critical: share of changed lines at tier critical
x-riffle-model-columns.touches_deprecated: any touched component has lifecycle deprecated
x-riffle-model-columns.policy_violations: count of policy rules broken by the diff
x-riffle-model-columns.in_freeze_window: PR opened inside a freeze window
x-riffle-model-columns.targets_release_branch: base branch class is release or hotfix
x-riffle-model-columns.author_is_owner: resolved author owns any touched path
x-riffle-model-columns.label_priority: 0-3 from pr_label priority, null if unlabeled
x-riffle-model-columns.is_safe_change_only: every changed line falls in a declared safe_change kind

x-riffle-mined-columns: See contracts/mined_features.schema.json. Mined columns are always present for every repo, including training repos; declared columns (x-riffle-model-columns) are null unless an org writes rules.
